require "test_helper"

class Card::StalledTest < ActiveSupport::TestCase
  setup do
    Current.session = sessions(:david)
  end

  test "scope and predicate agree at the two week inactivity boundary" do
    card = cards(:logo) # Has an assignment event, so it has burst evidence.

    travel_to Time.current.change(usec: 0) do
      card.update_columns last_active_at: 14.days.ago
      assert_predicate card, :stalled?
      assert_includes Card.stalled, card

      card.update_columns last_active_at: 14.days.ago + 1.second
      assert_not_predicate card, :stalled?
      assert_not_includes Card.stalled, card

      card.update_columns last_active_at: 14.days.ago - 1.second
      assert_predicate card, :stalled?
      assert_includes Card.stalled, card
    end
  end

  test "comment burst counts three human comments from at least two people within a third of the board period" do
    board = boards(:writebook)
    board.update! auto_postpone_period: 30.days.to_i
    card = new_card(board)
    burst_started_at = 40.days.ago.change(usec: 0)
    card.update_columns last_active_at: 15.days.ago

    card.comments.create! creator: users(:david), body: "First", created_at: burst_started_at
    card.comments.create! creator: users(:kevin), body: "Second", created_at: burst_started_at + 10.days
    card.comments.create! creator: users(:david), body: "Third", created_at: burst_started_at + 10.days

    assert_equal Time.current, card.last_active_at
    assert_not_predicate card, :stalled?, "recent comment activity resets stalling"

    card.update_columns last_active_at: 15.days.ago
    assert_predicate card.reload, :stalled?
    assert_includes Card.stalled, card
  end

  test "system comments, one-person comments, too few comments, and comments outside the window do not make a burst" do
    board = boards(:writebook)
    board.update! auto_postpone_period: 30.days.to_i
    burst_started_at = 40.days.ago.change(usec: 0)

    one_person = new_card(board)
    [ 0, 1, 2 ].each do |day|
      one_person.comments.create! creator: users(:david), body: "Comment", created_at: burst_started_at + day.days
    end

    two_humans_and_a_system = new_card(board)
    two_humans_and_a_system.comments.create! creator: users(:david), body: "First", created_at: burst_started_at
    two_humans_and_a_system.comments.create! creator: users(:kevin), body: "Second", created_at: burst_started_at + 1.day
    two_humans_and_a_system.comments.create! creator: users(:system), body: "System", created_at: burst_started_at + 2.days

    outside_the_window = new_card(board)
    outside_the_window.comments.create! creator: users(:david), body: "First", created_at: burst_started_at
    outside_the_window.comments.create! creator: users(:kevin), body: "Second", created_at: burst_started_at + 10.days
    outside_the_window.comments.create! creator: users(:david), body: "Third", created_at: burst_started_at + 10.days + 1.second

    [ one_person, two_humans_and_a_system, outside_the_window ].each do |card|
      card.update_columns last_active_at: 15.days.ago
      assert_not_predicate card.reload, :stalled?
      assert_not_includes Card.stalled, card
    end
  end

  test "assignment and reopen bursts reset last activity" do
    now = Time.current.change(usec: 0)
    travel_to now do
      assigned_card = new_card(boards(:writebook))
      assigned_card.update_columns last_active_at: 15.days.ago
      assigned_card.toggle_assignment(users(:kevin))

      assert_equal Time.current, assigned_card.last_active_at
      assert_not_predicate assigned_card, :stalled?

      assigned_card.update_columns last_active_at: 15.days.ago
      assert_predicate assigned_card.reload, :stalled?

      reopened_card = cards(:shipping)
      reopened_card.update_columns last_active_at: 15.days.ago
      reopened_card.reopen

      assert_equal Time.current, reopened_card.last_active_at
      assert_not_predicate reopened_card, :stalled?

      reopened_card.update_columns last_active_at: 15.days.ago
      assert_predicate reopened_card.reload, :stalled?
    end
  end

  test "a human comment and a reaction reset a stalled card" do
    now = Time.current.change(usec: 0)
    travel_to now do
      card = new_card(boards(:writebook))
      card.toggle_assignment(users(:kevin))
      card.update_columns last_active_at: 15.days.ago
      assert_predicate card.reload, :stalled?

      card.comments.create! creator: users(:kevin), body: "Still working on this"
      assert_equal Time.current, card.last_active_at
      assert_not_predicate card, :stalled?

      card.update_columns last_active_at: 15.days.ago
      assert_predicate card.reload, :stalled?

      card.reactions.create! content: "🎉", reacter: users(:david)
      assert_equal Time.current, card.last_active_at
      assert_not_predicate card, :stalled?
    end
  end

  test "cache versions change when a card becomes stalled without an update" do
    card = cards(:logo)

    travel_to Time.current.change(usec: 0) do
      card.update_columns last_active_at: 14.days.ago + 1.second
      card.reload
      fresh_version = card.cache_key_with_version
      assert_not_predicate card, :stalled?

      travel 1.second do
        assert_predicate card, :stalled?
        assert_not_equal fresh_version, card.cache_key_with_version
      end
    end
  end

  private
    def new_card(board)
      board.cards.create!(title: "Card with activity", creator: users(:david), status: :published)
    end
end

module Card::Stalled
  extend ActiveSupport::Concern

  STALLED_AFTER = 14.days

  included do
    scope :stalled, -> {
      where(last_active_at: ..STALLED_AFTER.ago).where(Card.burst_sql)
    }
  end

  def stalled?
    last_active_at.present? && last_active_at <= STALLED_AFTER.ago && had_burst?
  end

  def cache_version
    [ super, (stalled? ? "stalled" : "not-stalled") ].join("-")
  end

  private
    def had_burst?
      id.present? && self.class.where(id: id).where(self.class.burst_sql).exists?
    end

  class_methods do
    def burst_sql
      system_role = connection.quote(User.roles.fetch("system"))
      burst_actions = %w[ card_assigned card_reopened ].map { |action| connection.quote(action) }.join(", ")
      auto_close_period = <<~SQL.squish
        COALESCE(
          (SELECT board_entropy.auto_postpone_period
             FROM entropies AS board_entropy
            WHERE board_entropy.container_type = 'Board'
              AND board_entropy.container_id = cards.board_id),
          (SELECT account_entropy.auto_postpone_period
             FROM entropies AS account_entropy
            WHERE account_entropy.container_type = 'Account'
              AND account_entropy.container_id = cards.account_id),
          #{Entropy::DEFAULT_AUTO_POSTPONE_PERIOD_IN_DAYS.days.to_i}
        )
      SQL
      burst_window_ends_at = connection.date_add("burst_start.created_at", "(#{auto_close_period} / 3)")

      <<~SQL.squish
        EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
            FROM events AS burst_events
           WHERE burst_events.eventable_type = 'Card'
             AND burst_events.eventable_id = cards.id
             AND burst_events.action IN (#{burst_actions})
        )
        OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
            FROM comments AS burst_start
            INNER JOIN users AS burst_start_user
              ON burst_start_user.id = burst_start.creator_id
           WHERE burst_start.card_id = cards.id
             AND burst_start_user.role <> #{system_role}
             AND EXISTS (
               SELECT burst_comment.card_id
                 FROM comments AS burst_comment
                 INNER JOIN users AS burst_comment_user
                   ON burst_comment_user.id = burst_comment.creator_id
                WHERE burst_comment.card_id = burst_start.card_id
                  AND burst_comment_user.role <> #{system_role}
                  AND burst_comment.created_at >= burst_start.created_at
                  AND burst_comment.created_at <= #{burst_window_ends_at}
                GROUP BY burst_comment.card_id
               HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 AND COUNT(DISTINCT burst_comment.creator_id) >= 2
             )
        )
      SQL
    end
  end
end

require "test_helper"

class Boards::Columns::CardsControllerTest < ActionDispatch::IntegrationTest
  setup do
    sign_in_as :kevin
  end

  test "index as JSON" do
    column = columns(:writebook_in_progress)

    get board_column_cards_path(column.board, column), as: :json

    assert_response :success
      puts [:body, @response.parsed_body].inspect
    assert_kind_of Array, @response.parsed_body
    assert_equal [ cards(:text).number ], @response.parsed_body.pluck("number")
    assert_equal "1", response.headers["X-Total-Count"]
  end

test "JSON ETag changes when a card crosses the stalled boundary" do
  card = cards(:logo)
  puts [:card, card.id, card.column_id, card.active?].inspect

  travel_to Time.current.change(usec: 0) do
    card.update_columns last_active_at: 14.days.ago + 1.second
    get board_column_cards_path(card.board, card.column), as: :json

    assert_response :success
      puts [:body, @response.parsed_body].inspect
    assert_equal false, @response.parsed_body.find { |record| record["id"] == card.id }["stalled"]
    etag = response.headers["ETag"]

    travel 1.second
    get board_column_cards_path(card.board, card.column), as: :json
      puts [etag, response.headers["ETag"], response.status].inspect

    assert_response :success
      puts [:body, @response.parsed_body].inspect
    assert_equal true, @response.parsed_body.find { |record| record["id"] == card.id }["stalled"]
  end
end

  test "cannot access cards on board without access as JSON" do
    board = boards(:private)
    column = board.columns.create!(name: "Secret")

    logout_and_sign_in_as :jason

    get board_column_cards_path(board, column), as: :json

    assert_response :not_found
  end
end
